event_summary: A black kettlebell moves downward onto a yellow mug on a wooden table and remains there while the mug stays upright.
raw_event_description: At the start, a yellow mug sits upright on a wooden tabletop against a plain wall. A black kettlebell enters from the top of the frame, moves downward toward the mug, and its lower rounded part aligns above the mug opening. The kettlebell makes visible contact with the top of the mug and then stays positioned on the mug. The mug remains upright and visible, with no visible breakage or collapse.

The surrounding wall and tabletop provide a clear view of the setup.
